title: Assessment of the regenerative potential of surgically treated nerve injuries depending on the length of time between the injury and the operation
summary: Clinical examinations and questionnaires will be used to assess patients following surgical nerve repair. The aim is to identify factors that have a positive influence on nerve regeneration.
conditions: Peripheral nerve injury in the upper limb
Injury of unspecified nerve of upper limb, level unspecified

interventions.name:
Male and female patients following surgical nerve repair after complete transection of nerves in the upper limb.
